'''Danny Svehaug''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 San Diego tournament]] on 27 May 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court / Scum & Villainy]], according to Ryan Hase's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d888">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-13-san-diego-california-5-27-00d888/ san-diego-california-5-27-00], DeckTech (Ryan "heinekin" Hase, 13 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-13-san-diego-california-5-27-00d888/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
